metadata.datasource: ILFORD DELTA 3200 Professional fact sheet (September 2002), vector paths: spectral sensitivity (p1) and characteristic curve (p6). Copy from 125px.com's archive of ILFORD documents.

tags.log_sensitivity: SHEET 355-699 nm: the "wedge spectrogram to tungsten light (2850K)" taken as drawn; ASSUMED its 0-1 "Sensitivity" axis is log units and the source is not divided out (as HP5 Plus); ASSUMED held below 355 nm, ASSUMED log-linear tail -0.0436 dex/nm above 699 nm; scale MEASURED so grey 0.184 -> raw 1
tags.density_curves: SHEET for log_exposure -1.70..2.52 (ILFOTEC DD-X 1+4, 20 C, at EI 3200: 9.5 min, interpolated between the plotted 9 and 12 min curves; slope 0.3-1.5 over base+fog 0.556); ASSUMED flat toe below, ASSUMED straight line slope 0.182 into a ceiling of gross D 3.0 above
tags.log_exposure_anchor: ASSUMED: the sheet's exposure axis is relative. 0 = one log unit above the curve's own D = base+fog + 0.1 point, i.e. the film is taken to have exactly its rated speed (ISO 3200: log10(0.8/3200)+1.0 = -2.602 log lux-s)
tags.channel_density: ASSUMED: neutral silver, 1/3 per channel at every wavelength
tags.density_curves_layers: ASSUMED: three-CDF fit of the curve (max fit error 0.0120 D), no sheet data on emulsion sub-layers
